- Paper [15] discusses the Huber loss, but only in the context of regression tasks, not motion-bias correction.  
- Paper [5] uses warping-based motion compensation, but it is specific to video coding and does not involve learned cumulative-translation warping or motion-bias correction.  
Thus, no prior paper contains a substantively equivalent mechanism.
